    StartersGrandma's cheddar and chive cheese ballCream cheese and vintage cheddar ball with chives and WorcestershireHow to make it250g cream cheese, soft150g vintage cheddar, finely grated1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce1/2 tsp garlic powder1 bunch chives, chopped80g pecans200g water crackers4 celery sticks, cut into batonsBeat the cream cheese, cheddar, Worcestershire, garlic powder and most of the chives until smooth.Shape into a ball and wrap in cling film. Chill until firm.Toast the pecans in a dry pan, chop finely and mix with the remaining chives.Roll the cheese ball in the nuts and serve with crackers and celery.Brainasium game tester pizza scrollsRolled pizza dough with pepperoni and mozzarella, marinara to dunkHow to make it500g pizza dough100ml pizza sauce100g sliced pepperoni150g mozzarella, grated1 tsp dried oregano20g butter, melted1 garlic clove, crushed300ml marinara sauceRoll the dough on a floured bench into a large rectangle.Spread with pizza sauce and scatter with pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano.Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack into a greased 24cm tin.Brush with the melted butter and garlic, then bake at 200°C until golden.Warm the marinara and serve for dunking.MainsGrandma's glazed meatloaf with mashBeef and pork meatloaf with a sticky glaze, creamy mashed potatoHow to make it60g breadcrumbs180ml full cream milk500g beef mince300g pork mince1 onion, grated1 egg2 tsp Worcestershire sauce1 tsp salt100ml tomato sauce2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp cider vinegar1kg potatoes80g butter300g frozen peasSoak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk, then mix with the minces, onion, egg, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.Press into a lined loaf tin. Mix the tomato sauce, sugar and vinegar and spread over the top.Bake at 180°C, then rest.Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with most of the butter and the rest of the milk.Cook the peas and toss with the remaining butter. Slice the meatloaf and serve with mash and peas.SweetsGrandma's cinnamon tea cakeWarm butter cake brushed with cinnamon sugar, served with whipped creamHow to make it120g butter, soft180g caster sugar2 eggs1 tsp vanilla extract200g self-raising flour150ml full cream milk1 tsp ground cinnamon200ml thickened cream, whippedBeat most of the butter and most of the sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.Fold in the flour alternately with the milk and spread into a lined 20cm round tin.Bake at 180°C until a skewer comes out clean.While hot, brush with the remaining melted butter and sprinkle with the remaining sugar mixed with cinnamon.Serve warm in wedges with whipped cream.DrinksLilly, Bea and Grace's peach iced teaBlack tea with peach nectar and lemon over ice with fresh peachHow to make it6 black tea bags3 tbsp caster sugar400ml peach nectar2 lemons, 1 juiced and 1 sliced1 peach, sliced1 small bunch mint1 bag iceSteep the tea bags with the sugar in boiling water.Remove the bags, cool, then chill.Stir in the peach nectar and lemon juice.Fill glasses with ice and peach slices, pour over the tea and garnish with mint and lemon wheels.Ice cold cream sodaCold one for the testing floor, Alex.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
